description.value: Scratch Kitchen is a North Shore artisan pizza restaurant that started in Deep Cove in 2018 and expanded to Central Lonsdale in 2024; this record covers the Lonsdale location. Everything is made from scratch using fresh, locally sourced ingredients, with artisan pizzas, sharing plates, and salads paired alongside local craft beer and BC wine. The kitchen caters broadly to dietary needs, with gluten-free, dairy-free, and fully plant-based options available across the menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record and website contact page both confirm this is the Lonsdale location of Scratch Kitchen at 140 16th St W, North Vancouver, with phone 604-770-1199 — matching OSM exactly. The website confirms active operations with online ordering and call-for-pickup for the Lonsdale location, and the menu extensively labels GF, DF, and plant-based options. No website or OSM evidence addresses bike parking, washrooms, or water refill.
concerns: Website sitewide footer consistently displays the Deep Cove address (437 Dollarton Highway North) and phone (604) 770-1237, not the Lonsdale details. The contact subpage correctly lists both locations separately and confirms Lonsdale details match OSM, but the footer default could cause confusion for anyone skimming the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed active via website content and OSM check_date of 2026-03-24. A solid meal stop for touring cyclists in Central Lonsdale with broad dietary options and takeout available.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks items GF (gluten-free) and DF (dairy-free); all pizzas can be made gluten-free; vegan cashew mozza substitute available; website states 'We also cater to plant lovers and have lots of flavourful options available.'
